jobs.occupation: Morning shift warehouse employee FedEx Elst (229982)
jobs.description:
Start your morning actively at FedEx! Work from 05:00 to 09:30 with a friendly team sorting and checking packages. Earn €15.16 gross per hour, receive travel allowance, and get the chance for a permanent contract. Physical work, early hours, and plenty of growth opportunities. Read on!

Employment agency Manpower is looking for a warehouse employee for the morning shift at FedEx in Elst.

Together with your colleagues, you are responsible for processing all incoming packages and documents, while also checking their contents. In addition, you will be engaged in the following tasks:

    - Checking all packages with a scanner
    
- Sorting all packages on the conveyor belt
    
- Making sure packages end up in the correct delivery van
    
- Lifting light to heavier packages

Do you want to see what your workday at FedEx might look like? Watch the video at the bottom of the page!

What's in it for you

    - Gross salary of €15.16 per hour
    
- Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer
    
- Part-time job of 20 hours per week
    
- A contract with FedEx upon good performance
    
- Development opportunities through Manpower Academy (more than 200 online trainings)
    
- Long-term position
    
- Pension accrual via Manpower

    - At least 18 years old
    
- Heavy and physical work is not a problem for you
    
- Able to provide a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG)
    
- Good command of the Dutch or English language
    
- Own transport required (due to the working hours, it is difficult to reach the work location by public transport)

Is this your new job and would you like to apply? Then apply today before the vacancy closes, and Manpower will contact you within two working days!

As a warehouse operator, you will work in a dynamic logistics environment where chilled and frozen products are stored and distributed for various clients. You will work within fixed shifts: 07:00 to 18:00, 09:00 to 19:00, and 14:00 to 23:00 or 00:00. At the start, you can indicate your preference for two out of the three shifts. Based on your preference, you will be scheduled as much as possible in one fixed shift, providing structure and clarity in your working week.

In this role, you are responsible for maintaining an efficient and safe flow of goods within the warehouse. You will operate a reach truck daily to move pallets and pick orders. In addition, you will be involved in loading and unloading trucks, receiving and checking incoming goods, and managing stock locations. You will work with scanners and a modern WMS system, ensuring all processes are registered in real time and the logistics operation runs smoothly. You will also perform regular inventory checks and ensure all administrative processes are accurate. As you will be working in a chilled and frozen warehouse environment, appropriate workwear is provided to ensure you can work safely and comfortably. You are responsible for maintaining product quality and food safety by storing and handling goods at the correct temperatures and following FIFO and LIFO procedures.

With your accuracy, work pace, and sense of responsibility, you are an essential part of the logistics process and contribute directly to a reliable supply chain.

Do you want to work in a stable logistics organization where your efforts truly matter? Apply now and we will contact you shortly.

- Good command of Dutch and/or English

At AS Watson, you’ll work in a two-shift schedule and receive attractive bonuses of up to 150% per hour for late shifts. Plus, you’ll be part of a friendly team where collaboration is key.
